question: The Komagata Maru was a_____steamship
solution:
The correct answer is __**Japanese**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Komagata Maru was a **Japanese** steamship that was chartered by Indian immigrants in 1914.
 
• The ship was involved in a significant incident in Canadian history when it was denied entry into Canada, leading to a standoff that highlighted the exclusionary immigration policies of the time.
 
• The incident is an important event in the history of the Indian independence movement and Canadian immigration history.
 
• It has been commemorated in various forms, including memorials and historical accounts, recognizing its impact on civil rights and immigration policies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Komagata Maru sailed from Hong Kong to Vancouver, carrying 376 passengers from Punjab, India.
 
• Upon arrival, Canadian authorities refused to allow the passengers to disembark, citing the Continuous Journey Regulation, which required immigrants to travel directly from their country of origin.
 
• The ship was eventually forced to return to India, where some of the passengers were met with violence and arrest by British colonial authorities.
 
• The Komagata Maru incident has been recognized as a symbol of resistance against discriminatory laws and has inspired subsequent generations to fight for equal rights and justice.
